purpose: Estimate robustness uncertainty induced by hidden-calibration selector randomness, separately from malicious-worker-subset randomness, without retuning LIR-PPTD.
scientific_question: Do the principal B1 robustness conclusions remain stable when the hidden task-ID calibration selector is resampled independently rather than fixed to one mask per dataset?

frozen_semantics.selector_family: same task-ID HMAC/PRF Bernoulli selector as the final paper

methods.note: CRH/PPTD/TQPP predictions may be cached across selector seeds only if metrics are recomputed on each seed-specific ordinary-task scoring mask. LIR-PPTD must rerun because selector membership changes the persistent reputation trajectory.

primary_estimand.definition: For each dataset-rho-comparator cell and selector seed s, average paired loss deltas across the canonical malicious-worker subsets: Delta_bar_s = mean_j(L_LIR,s,j - L_comp,s,j).

secondary_hierarchical_inference.procedure: Nested bootstrap: resample selector seeds with replacement, then resample malicious subsets within each selected seed; report grand paired loss-delta CI.
secondary_hierarchical_inference.warning: The variance share is descriptive and is not labeled a formal ICC under unbalanced cells.

closure_gates: 20 fresh selector seeds per dataset are commitment-frozen before outcome inspection
all planned selector-stream pairs finish or every failure is retained and reported
no selector seed is removed, replaced, or rerun based on performance
selector randomness and malicious-subset randomness are independent
paired methods use the same realized calibration/scoring mask
no algorithm or parameter is retuned
Duck calibration-count distribution is reported explicitly
primary inference treats selector seed as the outer randomization unit

interpretation_policy.if_consistent: Strengthen robustness evidence by reporting selector-seed stability and retain existing bounded claims.
interpretation_policy.if_mixed: Retain results and narrow claims to regimes stable across selector seeds; do not search for a better seed.
interpretation_policy.if_reversed: Treat the reviewer concern as validated and revise the manuscript accordingly; do not retune the selector or algorithm within this study.

preexecution_seed_freeze.note: These 80 seeds were generated and commitment-frozen before any Round 6-2 performance outcome existed. Use these exact seeds; do not regenerate them.
